notes.title: New Mini-Game and Skins!
notes.notes:
Today, we released an update that added an exciting new mini-game! Jump in and give it a try!

We’ve also created new skins for the kettlebells specifically for the mini-game! They’ve been added to the list of skins that can be obtained.

Play, collect kettlebells, and enjoy the latest features of the update!

notes.title: Inventory update
notes.notes:
With today's update, an in-game inventory has been added. Now, players have the option to swap the kettlebell on the main game screen! Quickly replace the default kettlebell with a skin from your inventory and enjoy every click!

Stay tuned; there's much more to come!

notes.title: We've finally added skin drops!
notes.notes: Starting today, the feature to drop in-game items has been added. Now you can earn kettlebells every 3 hours! Jump into the game, earn kettlebells, trade them, and sell them on the market!

notes.title: RELEASE!!!
notes.notes:
Our game is finally released!

Starting today, the story of GymBro begins, and [u][b]YOU[/b][/u] can take part in it! The workshop will be added soon, allowing all players to create their own skins for the game!

The project is not yet fully complete and will undergo many improvements and updates! Currently, the main functionality of the game is presented! We have also added a wonderful mini-game that lets you showcase your mouse skills. 

We will share more about the project as the game develops. Stay tuned for updates and keep track of all the changes!

The GymBro Developers.
